AgentBuildNestedStackBuildNestedStackRes.Description: Rayito agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime (ADR-031): the one-agent infrastructure that `rayito agent deploy --target agentcore` deploys as the stack rayito-agentcore-<agent>, before it builds the image and creates the runtime through the AgentCore API. An ECR repository (immutable tags, scan on push, the last ImageRetentionCount images kept, emptied when the stack is deleted), the CodeBuild project that builds the linux/arm64 image from a source zip in the artifact bucket, its log group, and two roles with least privilege: the build role (read the source prefix, push to this repository, write its log group) and the runtime role AgentCore assumes (pull from this repository, write the runtime's logs, traces and metrics; Bedrock models and Secrets Manager secrets only when listed). Not an OptionalStack catalog component. Resource and property names: AWS_API_NOTES.md, "Despliegue en AgentCore Runtime".

RuntimeRoleArn.Description: The roleArn of CreateAgentRuntime and UpdateAgentRuntime.

Description.Fn::Sub: Rayito: linux/arm64 image of the agent web-agent for AgentCore Runtime

Source.BuildSpec:
version: 0.2
phases:
  pre_build:
    commands:
      - aws ecr get-login-password --region "$AWS_REGION" | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin "${REPOSITORY_URI%%/*}"
  build:
    commands:
      - docker build --platform linux/arm64 --build-arg "AGENT_BASE_IMAGE=$AGENT_BASE_IMAGE" -t "$REPOSITORY_URI:$IMAGE_TAG" .
  post_build:
    commands:
      - test "$CODEBUILD_BUILD_SUCCEEDING" = "1" && docker push "$REPOSITORY_URI:$IMAGE_TAG"
